headline: the repository's own test suite was uncollectable; 23 collection errors, all stale pins or missing packages, none a code defect

causes.cause: effect-class registry pinned to LINE NUMBERS
causes.detail: five of six _LEGACY_LINE_REMAP entries for astra_runtime.py pointed at lines that no longer contain subprocess.run (781/859/1309/1653/6405 had drifted to 862/940/1408/1769/6539); python_test_audit 136 -> 144
causes.fix: re-anchored; obligation count unchanged, six sites in and six out

causes.cause: verification records pinned to FILE CONTENT HASHES
causes.detail: test_epistemic_closure_kernel_v1.py was legitimately extended in r50 and the pinned sha was never updated; two other pins stale in the same records
causes.fix: re-anchored with provenance appended to the record

causes.cause: module-scope import of cadquery, which needs libGL.so.1
causes.detail: a missing system library made the file a COLLECTION ERROR, which takes the whole summary down with it
causes.fix: unittest.SkipTest with the reason; a missing library is a skip, not a verdict

the_law: a stale pin does not fail loudly, it makes tests DISAPPEAR -- so the failure is invisible to anyone who does not run the whole suite, which is everyone
implication: every green reported in this project up to r116 was a green on a hand-picked file; the suite that would have contradicted it could not be loaded
needed_next: the pins are still maintained by hand, and they will drift again. The durable fix is content-addressed effect sites (hash the function body) and auto-re-anchoring verification records, not more manual updates
